verdict.rationale: Cursor's marketing docs explicitly claim support for always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to build, maintain, and fix software (cursor-docs-9), directly matching the story. However, this is only vendor marketing copy with no independent/hands-on verification in the evidence pack, and community feedback elsewhere raises general reliability concerns about the product (bugginess, hallucinated policies), so confidence in real-world delivery of this specific feature is limited.
